title: Can I BEAT Pawnbarian?
summary: First Pawnbarian episode: a chess-themed roguelike deck-builder. He completes the Tutorial Island (learning that cards move the hero like chess pieces, promotion in the top row, loot decay, shop) and then the first area through to its final boss.
rules: Pawnbarian (Steam roguelike deck-builder): you control a single hero on a small grid (~5x5) against monsters.

Each turn you get 2 moves/actions; choose from 3 random cards drawn from your deck; each card is a chess piece (pawn, knight, bishop, rook, queen, king) and moves/attacks the hero with that piece's pattern.
Attack enemies by moving into them (like a capture). Kill all enemies on the floor to continue.
After your moves, monsters attack: ending your turn on a square they target (red notches mark targeted squares) costs a heart.

Promotion: moving into the top row (or starting a turn there / having three pawns in hand) promotes the rightmost eligible card in hand (e.g. pawn -> queen); moving a pawn card forward can gain an extra action.

Loot row above the board: rightmost loot item is lost each turn, so faster floors give more loot; crystals heal 1 heart, gold buys upgrades/hearts/piece cards in the shop between floors (knight cheap, rook ~6 gold).

Monster abilities: horned Cappy Bear can only be attacked from diagonal squares; Blight host spawns blight sacs on adjacent empty squares after death; Spider toad restricts card draw to two after death; champions immune; snakes must be attacked when adjacent; bosses at the end of an area.
Areas: Tutorial Island, Goblin Caves, Golem Fortress, Foul Shrine.
win_condition: Clear every floor of an area and defeat its final boss without losing all hearts.
